postconditions.probe: select not exists (select 1 from public.agent_tool_grants g where public.agent__gateway_tool_spec(g.agent_id, g.agent_version, g.tool_id, g.tool_version) is null)

postconditions.name: execution_paid_calls_and_billing_still_disabled
postconditions.probe: select (select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(not enabled) from public.agent_execution_enablement) and (select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(not enabled) from public.agent_model_enablement) and (select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(customer_billing_mode = 'disabled' and not stripe_trueup_enabled) from public.agent_customer_billing_controls) and public.agent__billing_mode() = 'disabled'

postconditions.name: no_live_agent_worker_or_running_run_after_apply
postconditions.probe: select not exists (select 1 from public.agent_worker_heartbeats where status in ('starting', 'running', 'draining') and last_seen_at > now() - interval '1 hour') and not exists (select 1 from public.agent_runs where state in ('running', 'cancel_requested'))

postconditions.name: h1_queue_still_logged
postconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pgmq.meta where queue_name = 'patelrep_agent_runs_v1' and not is_unlogged) and (select count(*) from pgmq.meta) = 1
